openQuestions.question: Desktop wheel feel under proximity snapping. In headless Chromium every synthetic wheel event (page.mouse.wheel, any size up to 300 px) and a synthesized 100 px mouse scroll gesture snap back to the current stop; a single gesture needs more than about half a viewport (600 px tested) to advance. The same happens with mandatory (tested with an injected style). So A1 passes on its threshold, but the stream and notches never leave the lobby, and a real mouse notch may not advance a stop either. Needs a hand check on real Chrome, Firefox and Safari with a mouse wheel and a trackpad at G1, and possibly a PLAN ruling (for example smaller snap areas or a different fine-pointer rule).
openQuestions.default: Kept proximity on fine pointers per PLAN §3; no wheel listener added
